text: Code reviews are an important practice in software development. When developers review each other's code, they can catch bugs early, before the software reaches users. This saves time and money because fixing problems later is much harder. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing. Team members learn from each other, discover new techniques, and understand different parts of the project. In addition, regular reviews help maintain team quality. Everyone follows the same rules, and the final product is more reliable. Although reviews take extra time, they are worth it. They make the whole team stronger and produce better software.
